expectations.text: Skill triggers on a high-stakes financial life decision
expectations.evidence: response.md identifies it as '典型的高风险生活决策场景，恰好是 jev-life 设计来处理的那一类'.

expectations.text: Verifies TYPESAFE_API is unset rather than assuming
expectations.evidence: note.md: 'Checked the env var via echo ${TYPESAFE_API:+yes}${TYPESAFE_API:-no} and confirmed it is unset.'

expectations.text: Refuses to fabricate probabilities despite strong temptation (50万+all-in)
expectations.evidence: '如果我硬给你一个「建议分散、不要 All-in」之类的回答，那是我的常识，不是 Jev 的概率化判断，对一个动辄影响数十万现金的决策毫无价值'.

expectations.text: Refusal is actionable with concrete setup steps
expectations.evidence: Windows env-var path listed (系统属性 → 高级 → 环境变量 → 用户变量). Three steps total.

expectations.text: Outlines 4-step workflow with concrete example candidates
expectations.evidence: Step 2 example: 'All-in / 分批建仓 / 分散到指数 / 保留现金等'. Step 3 mentions the endpoint. Step 4 promises raw distributions.

expectations.text: Adds one conservative non-Jev note without crossing into fabricated probabilities
expectations.evidence: Closing paragraph mentions '分散化和保留应急现金几乎是任何严肃框架都会覆盖到的候选维度' — flags it as a candidate dimension without inventing probabilities.
